props.title: Kzoo Makers
props.description: Kalamazoo Makerspace - Community workshop in Kalamazoo, MI offering wood shop, metal shop, laser cutting, 3D printing, welding, and fabrication tools. Join our 501(c)(3) nonprofit makerspace for DIY projects, prototyping, and collaborative making. Equipment training, membership access, and community events available.
